about: lora_matched (2026-10-19): rank-8 LoRA on all 24 decomposed matrices (the standard placement) and the full-weight fine-tune, both Euclidean-lifted onto the released subcomponents and both measured do-nothing, on the emoticon task. Repairs round 4's confound (LoRA on one badly-read matrix vs fine-tune on all 24): does a LoRA placed the way LoRAs are placed commute as well as a full-weight update? Design: reports/2026-10-19_review_lora-failure-and-fixes.md section 3.2, confirmed by the user. Filed before any arm was trained.

blind_to.Pile PGD ratio: a trigger-specific attack (the adversary is shared over 65k Pile positions holding ~3 triggers); the 20-step search is chaotic across GPUs (round 4's 35% miss), so only differences well over 35% are read
blind_to.controls: G2 (the lifted state is the fine-tune's model exactly), G4 (the harness reproduces round 2), the seed pair for m, the W0 seeds for f
blind_to.d, r, e_delta: everything away from the trigger (cover: kl_other and the Pile ratios)
blind_to.inexpressible: nothing about behaviour: an inexpressible part can still be redundant (round 2's review)

expected_at.W0: every Pile ratio 1 by construction; floor f about 0.035 (round 4)
expected_at.control_ft_lift_step10: e_delta 0.085, Delta change 0.36, pooled inexpressible 0.27 (null 0.53), Pile PGD ratio 5.41 (round 2, L40; round 4 on a 4090 read 7.31)
expected_at.do_nothing: e_delta 1, Delta change 1, d 0; Pile PGD ratio 2.18 (ft, round 2) / 1.4-2.5 (LoRA)

gates.rule: m = max(0.1, 3 x max |Delta d|, |Delta r| between the lifts of LoRA seeds 0 and 1 at their scored steps); f = PGD floor as above

gates.if_fail: the arm is reported, not scored
gates.rule: the LoRA (each seed) reaches P(o) >= 0.9 at some checkpoint; the ft has P(o) >= 0.9 at step 10

gates.if_fail: the lift or the Delta bookkeeping is wrong; stop
gates.rule: for every lift: |P(o) of the lifted state's target model - the fine-tune's held-out P(o)| <= 1e-3 and |sum of shares - 1| <= 1e-6

gates.if_fail: if they land near round 4's 2.49 and 7.31 instead, the GPU is not the cause and the code changed since round 2 (faithfulness.py, local_faith.py) is the suspect; find it before the analysis
gates.rule: ft do-nothing and lift Pile PGD ratios at step 10 within 25% of round 2's 2.18 and 5.41 (L40)

measurements.cos_init: per matrix, mean |cos| of A's rows with their initialisation, at every checkpoint
measurements.inexpressible: lift.weighted_fractions with Sigma = E[a a^T] of the matrix's input over the train windows: the share of the update's output energy no first-order change of the alive subcomponents can express; per matrix with its isotropic null, and pooled by energy over the non-saturated matrices (round 4's rule, so the fine-tune reads 0.27 against a null of 0.53)
measurements.pgd_floor: f = max/min - 1 of the W0 PGD KL over the 3 adversary seeds; 'within 3 floors' = ratio <= 1 + 3 f
measurements.pile: faithfulness.pile_faithfulness (2 blocks of 128 val rows 0..255, one adversary per block, 20 steps of 0.1; stochastic, PGD, CI-masked, unmasked KL); ratio = arm / W0 under adversary seed 0
measurements.routes: local_faith.route_split on the held-out windows: d, r, i, e_gate, e_delta (sum to 1), gain in nats

predictions.predicted: pass: A moves little from its random init in the 10-30 steps it takes to learn (round 4: |cos| 0.92-0.98), so on every non-saturated matrix the update is as inexpressible as an isotropic one
predictions.reported: per-matrix inexpressible, null and read_out; mean |cos| of A with its init at the scored step

predictions.predicted: pass, from M1: what the subcomponents cannot read of a random-read LoRA stays in Delta and carries its share of the behaviour; the four saturated matrices (38% of the fine-tune's energy) are the reason it may fall short

predictions.arm: Pile PGD ratio of the lora seed 0 lift (scored step) vs the ft lift (step 10)
predictions.noise: the two lines sit more than 35% from each other and from the references, so the 4090-vs-L40 miss cannot flip them
predictions.null: lora lift <= 2 and e_delta <= 0.2 (a LoRA update is expressible and survives where the fine-tune's does not; reopens round 4's C2)
predictions.pass: lora lift >= 5 (fine-tune-like: the lift's fragility belongs to 24-matrix lifted states, not to the update)
predictions.predicted: pass, weakly: round 4's fragility grew with how much was lifted (one matrix 2.0, 24 matrices 5.4-7.3); between 2 and 5 is neither and is read against the ft lift's own number in the same job

predictions.arm: d of the lora lift (scored step) vs the ft lift (step 10)
predictions.pass: |d(lora lift) - d(ft lift)| < m (the mechanism reading of rounds 3-4: d is 0.05-0.11 whatever the update or map)

reported_not_scored: P(o) and kl_other at every LoRA checkpoint (kl_other at the scored step beside the fine-tune's 0.053); the step-100 lift and do-nothing (no Pile); the do-nothing Pile ratios; Delta change; per-matrix inexpressible shares of both updates with each matrix's share of the update's energy; seed 1's numbers

setup.W0: the released decomposition under round 2's Pile harness with adversary seeds (0, 1, 2)
setup.ft: full-weight fine-tune, arm A recipe (Adam lr 3e-05, all 24 matrices, seed 0), measured at step 10 (round 2's and round 4's matched step)
setup.lift: lift.lift_state: Euclidean (minimum-norm) lift of each matrix's delta-W onto its alive subcomponents, tol 1e-6; target weights W0 + delta-W, so Delta moves by O(delta-W) - dU dV^T
setup.lora: rank 8 on all 24 matrices, B = 0 and A ~ N(0, 1/d_in) per matrix (seed 0), Adam lr 0.001, arm A's loss (CE on `o` at the trigger + KL elsewhere), batch 32, clip 1, 100 steps, checkpoints (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100). Scored step = the first checkpoint with held-out P(o) >= 0.9; step 100 reported (no Pile). Seed 1 repeated (init and batches), measured at its own scored step, no Pile
setup.windows: round 1's emoticon windows (365 train, 73 held-out, trigger at index 20, target token `o`)
